mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS noteId, n.title AS title, CASE WHEN n.type = 0 AND n.img_uris IS NOT NULL AND n.img_uris != '' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(n.img_uris, ',', 1) WHEN n.type = 1 THEN n.video_uri ELSE NULL END AS cover, n.type AS type, n.create_time AS createTime, IFNULL(nc.like_total, 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(nc.collect_total, 0) AS collectCount, IFNULL(nc.comment_total, 0) AS commentCount, COALESCE(c.name, n.topic_name) AS channelName FROM note n LEFT JOIN note_count nc ON nc.note_id = n.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT topic_id, MIN(channel_id) AS channel_id FROM channel_topic_rel GROUP BY topic_id ) tc ON tc.topic_id = n.topic_id LEFT JOIN channel c ON c.id = tc.channel_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE n.creator_id = #{creatorId} AND n.status = #{status} AND n.create_time >= #{startTime} AND n.create_time < #{endTime} ORDER BY n.id DESC

SELECT n.id AS noteId, n.title AS title, CASE WHEN n.type = 0 AND n.img_uris IS NOT NULL AND n.img_uris != '' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(n.img_uris, ',', 1) WHEN n.type = 1 THEN n.video_uri ELSE NULL END AS cover, n.type AS type, n.creator_id AS creatorId, nc.like_total AS likeCount FROM note_count nc INNER JOIN note n ON n.id = nc.note_id WHERE n.status = #{normalStatus} AND n.visible = #{publicVisible} AND nc.like_total > 0 ORDER BY nc.like_total DESC, n.create_time DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
